pairs.question: Quid ergo credimus iudicem illum, si non et ultorem?
pairs.answer: Hoc se nobis repromittit dicens: Vindictam mihi et ego uindicabo.
pairs.derivation: Author poses a real interrogative ("what then do we believe that judge to be, if not also an avenger?") and answers it himself: God promises this very thing. Answer ends at the first full stop, cutting before the appended gloss "id est: «patientiam mihi et ego patientiam remunerabo»", which interprets rather than answers the question. The speech-framing "dicens" is retained because it is part of the author's answering assertion, not narration of an exchange between characters.
